title: Add docked Log | Timeline toggle inside #event-section and per-character swimlanes in TimelineView

sections.what: Support an inline docked Log | Timeline mode toggle right inside #event-section (in addition to the full-screen modal) and add per-character swimlanes to TimelineView.
sections.why: Phase 4 of the Timeline Vision calls for unified EventStream/Timeline navigation rather than forcing a separate modal overlay every time the user inspects scenario chronology.
sections.how: Refactor TimelineView (static/js/stream/timeline-view.ts) to expose mount(containerEl, opts) alongside open() modal, adding a Lanes: Branches | Characters swimlane mode toggle. Add a Log | Timeline segmented switcher in #timeline-branch-bar (static/js/stream/timeline-bar.ts) that toggles #event-stream visibility against a flex:1 docked #timeline-docked-host inside #event-section.

acceptance.text: #timeline-branch-bar includes a Log | Timeline segmented toggle switching #event-section cleanly between the vertical event log and an inline docked Timeline view
Docked and modal Timeline views support per-character swimlanes toggle (Branches vs Characters) with fluid responsive sizing, zoom, search, hover tooltips, and click-to-inspect/redo

custom.browser_ui: Inside #event-section, clicking Timeline in the Log | Timeline toggle switches the pane inline to a fluid, scrollable Timeline with Branches/Characters swimlane modes, while clicking Log returns to the vertical stream.
